name: Close panel
summary: This is a trade management utility panel that provides a graphical interface for quickly closing positions on the current chart symbol. It does not open trades based on any strategy signals; it serves as a convenient order management dashboard for traders to manually close all or specific positions.
summary_zh: 这是一个交易管理工具面板，提供图形界面用于快速平仓当前图表品种的持仓。它不基于任何策略信号开仓，而是作为订单管理仪表盘方便交易者手动平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略型EA，而是一个纯工具类面板。其核心功能是提供一键平仓操作界面，允许用户通过点击面板按钮快速关闭当前品种的所有持仓或多空分类持仓。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不会自动开仓。出场条件由用户手动触发，通过面板按钮执行平仓操作。仓位管理方面，该EA仅负责关闭现有仓位，不涉及开仓仓位计算。资金管理同样不适用，因为没有任何自动下单逻辑。整体而言，这是一个辅助性工具，旨在提升交易者的操作效率，减少手动逐个平仓的繁琐步骤。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy EA but a pure utility panel. Its core function is to provide a one-click close position interface, allowing users to quickly close all positions or filtered long/short positions on the current symbol via panel buttons. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open trades automatically. Exit conditions are manually triggered by the user through panel buttons to execute close operations. Position sizing is not relevant as the EA only handles closing existing positions, not opening new ones. Money management is similarly not applicable since there is no automated order placement logic. Overall, this is an auxiliary tool designed to improve trader operational efficiency and reduce the tedious steps of manually closing positions one by one.
pros: 提供一键平仓功能，大幅提升操作效率，尤其在行情剧烈波动时能快速响应
图形化面板界面直观易用，降低了手动逐个平仓的操作复杂度
可以按多空方向分类平仓，提供更灵活的仓位管理选择
pros_en: Provides one-click close functionality, significantly improving operational efficiency especially during volatile market conditions
Graphical panel interface is intuitive and easy to use, reducing the complexity of manually closing positions one by one
Allows closing positions by direction (long/short), offering more flexible position management options
cons: 作为纯工具型EA，不具备任何自动交易能力，无法产生自主交易信号
缺乏确认对话框，一键平仓可能导致误操作带来不必要的损失
面板界面可能与其他指标或EA的面板重叠，影响使用体验
cons_en: As a pure utility EA, it has no automated trading capability and cannot generate its own trading signals
Lacks confirmation dialogs, one-click closing may lead to accidental operations causing unnecessary losses
Panel interface may overlap with other indicator or EA panels, affecting user experience
improvements: 增加平仓前的确认对话框，防止误操作导致意外平仓
添加选择性平仓功能，如按盈亏比例、手数大小等条件筛选平仓
improvements_en: Add a confirmation dialog before closing positions to prevent accidental closures
Add selective closing features, such as filtering positions by profit/loss ratio, lot size, or other conditions

risk_points: 一键平仓无确认机制，存在误操作风险
多账户或多品种环境下可能误平其他品种持仓
risk_points_en: One-click closing without confirmation mechanism poses accidental operation risk
May accidentally close positions of other symbols in multi-account or multi-symbol environments

summary_en: This is a trade management utility panel that provides a graphical interface for quickly closing positions on the current chart symbol. It does not open trades based on any strategy signals; it serves as a convenient order management dashboard for traders to manually close all or specific positions.
